output.incidentTitle: Revenue Loss on Roku (us-east) due to Beacon Failure, Auto-Remediated
output.postmortem: Timeline: Incident INC-1788132143831 began at 2026-08-30T23:22:23.831Z. Automated remediation was triggered immediately. Root Cause: A high impression gap (75%) was isolated to the Roku device class in the us-east region. Upstream ad delivery health was normal, indicating a failure of client-side impression beacon collection (Failure Class F07). Evidence: Key metrics showed `impression_gap_affected: 0.75` while `impression_gap_others: 0`. Other failure classes were ruled out: CDN errors (`cdn_5xx: 0`), ad fill issues (`ads_nofill_rate: 0`), and ad pod duration underfill (`ads_pod_seconds_filled: 0.875`) were all within healthy thresholds. Action Taken: The automated runbook `rb-beacon-fallback` was executed. A configuration patch was applied via `POST ssai/admin/beacon-mode` to switch the `roku` device class to `server_side` beaconing mode. Verification: The action was successful, confirmed by a `200 OK` status. Post-remediation metrics show the impression gap was reduced to 0, indicating full recovery and a total revenue leak of $8.08.
